read.thesis: Electrical Americas orders up 16% TTM with backlog up 31% to $13.2B, but a capacity ramp cuts segment margin 180bp to 29.8%, with about 130bp more ramp drag guided for 2026.

capex.quote: we've already announced investments around $1.5 billion to strategically expand capacity

triggers.label: ESA ramp drag 100bp → ~130bp in 2026
triggers.quote: we see an impact of about 130 basis points in the full costs would be front-end loaded. 2026.

triggers.label: ESA backlog up 31% to $13.2B
triggers.quote: backlog grew 31% year over year to a record $13.2 billion

triggers.label: Data center orders up ~200%
triggers.quote: Our orders accelerated approximately 200%, and our sales were up above 40% versus Q4 2024.

triggers.label: Share buyback suspended for 2026
triggers.quote: we do not plan to buy back shares in 2026, due to the pending Boyd deal

guidance.quote: we expect the total company to be between 7% to 9% in 2026
our adjusted EPS is expected to be between $13 and $13.50
For cash flow, our guidance is $3.9 billion to $4.3 billion
including organic growth of 5% to 7% and operating margins of 22.2% to 20.6%

prior_guidance_check.quote: we delivered on our 2025 adjusted earnings commitment

prior_guidance_check.metric: 2030 segment margin 28%, EPS growth 12%+, 6-9% organic growth
prior_guidance_check.quote: We committed to a growth between 6-9% top-line growth for the period.

red_flags.label: Electrical Americas margin down 180bp on ramp costs
red_flags.quote: Operating margin of 29.8% was down 180 basis points versus prior year, largely driven by capacity ramp cost.

red_flags.label: Vehicle organic revenue down 13%
red_flags.quote: the business declined by 13% on an organic basis, primarily driven by weaknesses in the North America truck and light vehicle markets

evasions.topic: Capacity ramp timing and when it turns to tailwind
evasions.quote: Expect progress in Q2, I would say expect momentum into Q3. Then a stronger pace of backlog liquidation in Q4

evasions.quote: So I don't wanna give you a breakdown there
